meta.title: Minority rights
meta.question: Should national and ethnic minorities have more rights?
meta.measure: Average position on minority rights, from 0 (more rights) to 10 (the majority first)
meta.anchor: Pooled from questions on state support for minorities' customs and on majority rule over minority rights, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question. Only three surveys ask them.

items.wording: What policy should the authorities pursue towards the German minority: help it cultivate German culture (0), restrict its activity (7), or encourage its members to leave for Germany (10)? ('another opinion' is no position)
Should the German minority have the right to learn its language in state schools?
Should the Ukrainian minority have the right to learn its language in state schools?
Should the German minority have the right to sit in the Sejm and Senate?
Should the Ukrainian minority have the right to sit in the Sejm and Senate?
Ethnic minorities should be given government assistance to preserve their customs and traditions (agree-disagree)
The law should protect the interests of the majority; minorities that want to live in Poland must accept this
Democracy means that the minority yields to the majority
How important for democracy is respecting and protecting the rights of minorities?
Should they receive state funding to maintain their culture and traditions?
Should members of national or ethnic minorities be able to learn their language in Polish schools in extra lessons?
Should they be able to use their own language in local offices where they live?
Should they be able to be taught in their own language?
Should they be able to put up place-name signs in their own language beside the Polish ones?
Should their parties be exempt from the 5% national threshold for the Sejm?
Are you in favour of or opposed to specific measures to provide equal opportunities in employment for people of different ethnic origin?
How important is it for democracy in general that the rights of minority groups are protected?
items.notes: European Social Survey rounds 6 (2012) and 10 (2021-22) (2 surveys; round 10 becomes ESS_RGHMGPR_SC).

items.wording: The will of the majority should always prevail, even over the rights of minorities (agree-disagree)
When there is a conflict between a minority and the majority, should the authorities always side with the majority?
items.notes: SWPS COVID tracker waves 4, 6, 9, 15 (4 online surveys; dates provisional except wave 9). The PGSW wording behind PGSW_MAJORITY_PREVAILS, as yes/no.

items.wording: How important is it for democracy in general that the rights of minority groups are protected?
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: How important for democracy is it that the rights of minority groups are protected? (0 not at all ... 10 extremely)
items.notes: NCN Opus online panel waves 1 and 3 (April 2023, April 2024; 2 surveys). Wave 2's labels are cut short and cannot be matched. The ESS rghmgpr wording.

items.wording: Is 'the majority can always outvote the minority' a fundamental feature of democracy?
items.notes: NCN Opus online panel wave 3, April 2024 (1 survey). Two copies of the variable; the first is used.

items.wording: Is 'the minority must accept the will of the majority in all circumstances' a fundamental feature of democracy?
items.notes: NCN Opus online panel wave 3, April 2024 (1 survey).

items.wording: Businesses serving the public should have to treat all customers equally, whatever their origin
items.notes: FNW SWPS online survey December 2025 (1 survey).

items.wording: Private firms should have the right not to employ members of certain minorities, even if this is unjust
items.notes: FNW SWPS online survey December 2025 (1 survey).

items.wording: Is 'the majority can always overrule the minority' a fundamental feature of democracy?
items.notes: BDCS survey 2025 (1 survey). The file also holds Polish-labelled copies, which the English regex does not match.

items.wording: The rights of minorities should always be upheld, even when they are not consistent with the preferences of the majority
Is 'the minority must accept the will of the majority in all circumstances' a fundamental feature of democracy?
